check: Validate asset records against existing schemas
command:
python - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
from jsonschema import Draft202012Validator
for schema_path, records in (
    (Path('manifests/character-manifest.schema.json'), [Path('manifests/characters.json')]),
    (Path('provenance/schema/provenance.schema.json'), sorted(Path('provenance').glob('*/*.json'))),
):
    schema = json.loads(schema_path.read_text())
    Draft202012Validator.check_schema(schema)
    validator = Draft202012Validator(schema)
    for record in records:
        if record == schema_path:
            continue
        validator.validate(json.loads(record.read_text()))
        print('VALID', record)
PY
